text:
Both tests pass and the issue's examples now produce the expected output. The fix was minimal:

1. Changed the regex from `[^a-z0-9]` to `[^a-z0-9]+` so runs of non-alphanumeric characters collapse into a single hyphen (fixes `hello--world-` → `hello-world`).
2. Added `.strip("-")` to remove leading/trailing hyphens (fixes `--a--b--` → `a-b`).

The public signature is unchanged.

arguments.summary: Fixed slugify in textkit/slug.py by changing the replacement regex from `[^a-z0-9]` to `[^a-z0-9]+` (collapsing consecutive non-alphanumeric characters into a single hyphen) and adding `.strip("-")` to remove leading/trailing hyphens. This makes `slugify("Hello,  World!")` return `"hello-world"` and...
